ja302:1.1: Adeyyesu dadaṃ dānaṃ deyyesu na-ppavecchati āpāsu vyasanaṃ patto sahāyaṃ nādhigacchati.
ja302:2.1: Nādeyyesu dadaṃ dānaṃ deyyesu yo pavecchati āpāsu vyasanaṃ patto sahāyaṃ adhigacchati.
ja302:3.1: Saññogasambhogavisesadassanaṃ anariyadhammesu saṭhesu nassati, katañ ca ariyesu ca añjayesu ca mahapphalaṃ hoti aṇum pi tādisu.
ja302:4.1: Yo pubbe katakalyāṇo akā lokesu dukkaraṃ pacchā kayira na vā kayirā accantaṃ pūjanāraho ti.
